charts.title: K2-3 c: orbits around K2-3
charts.description: The orbits of K2-3's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-3 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022 (2022AJ....164..172D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DIAMOND_LOWE_ET_AL__2022): P 24.646729 d

charts.title: K2-3 c: its transit
charts.description: K2-3 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 173103335, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 20 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 14-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min early; 14-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
